text_block_list.text:
With all of Симболи Рудольф's races over,
now is as
good a time as any to reflect
on her
achievements.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The weight atop my head has grown
rather
crushing since the days of my
debut.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But if that is the price of the Emperor's
glory,
then so be it!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That is precisely why I sought
them.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I'm proud to be your trainer.

text_block_list.text:
I daresay we have earned ourselves one
day of
merriment.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Let's make the most of it, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
